nodes.label: __enter__
nodes.summary: Initializes resources needed for the context manager before executing the block.

nodes.label: __exit__
nodes.summary: Cleans up resources and handles exceptions after the block finishes.

nodes.label: pubsub_message_framer
nodes.summary: Frames a Pub/Sub message for transmission to clients.

nodes.label: apply_transaction
nodes.summary: Executes queued transaction commands atomically, returning results or errors.

nodes.label: handle_command
nodes.summary: Routes incoming commands to appropriate handler functions based on command type.

nodes.label: _handle_get
nodes.summary: Retrieves the value associated with a key, returning nil if absent.

nodes.label: _handle_set
nodes.summary: Stores a value under a key, optionally setting expiration and returning previous value.

nodes.label: _handle_del
nodes.summary: Deletes specified keys and returns the count of keys removed.

nodes.label: _handle_expire
nodes.summary: Sets a key's time-to-live, returning success status.

nodes.label: _handle_exists
nodes.summary: Checks whether a key exists, returning a boolean result.

nodes.label: _handle_subscribe
nodes.summary: Adds a client to a channel's subscriber list, acknowledging subscription.

nodes.label: _handle_publish
nodes.summary: Broadcasts a message to all subscribers of a channel, returning subscriber count.

nodes.label: _handle_staleness
nodes.summary: Reports the staleness status of a key, indicating if it has expired.

nodes.label: _handle_snapshot
nodes.summary: Provides a snapshot of the current database state for persistence.

nodes.label: _handle_members
nodes.summary: Lists all members of a set, returning them as an array.

nodes.label: _handle_leave
nodes.summary: Removes a client from a channel, updating subscription records.

nodes.label: _handle_role
nodes.summary: Returns the role of the current client (e.g., master, slave).

nodes.label: _handle_verify
nodes.summary: Validates a client's authentication token and updates session state.

nodes.label: _handle_lock
nodes.summary: Acquires a distributed lock for a resource, returning lock status.

nodes.label: _handle_unlock
nodes.summary: Releases a previously acquired lock, ensuring ownership.

nodes.label: _handle_fenced_set
nodes.summary: Sets a key only if a provided fence value matches the current value.

nodes.label: _handle_multi
nodes.summary: Begins a transaction block, queuing subsequent commands.

nodes.label: _handle_discard
nodes.summary: Aborts a transaction, clearing queued commands.

nodes.label: _handle_watch
nodes.summary: Monitors keys for changes, marking transaction as dirty if altered.

nodes.label: _handle_unwatch
nodes.summary: Stops monitoring all keys for the current transaction.

nodes.label: _handle_exec
nodes.summary: Executes queued transaction commands if no watched keys changed, returning results.

nodes.label: _handle_txstatus
nodes.summary: Reports the current transaction status, indicating if a transaction is active.

nodes.label: _log_state_change
nodes.summary: Records a state transition event, capturing previous and new states for audit and debugging purposes.

nodes.label: voter_peer_ids
nodes.summary: Returns a list of peer IDs participating in the election process.

nodes.label: observe_higher_epoch
nodes.summary: Monitors for a higher epoch number and triggers a leadership change when detected.

nodes.label: wake
nodes.summary: Notifies the leadership component to re-evaluate its state or perform an action immediately.

nodes.label: _log_state_change
nodes.summary: Logs the transition of a node's state within the election ring, recording previous and new states.

nodes.label: handle
nodes.summary: Processes incoming Redis commands, routing them to the appropriate handler and returning the result.

nodes.label: refresh_from
nodes.summary: Updates the manager's state from a given configuration snapshot.

nodes.label: GetConfig
nodes.summary: Retrieves the current membership configuration for the cluster.

nodes.label: ProposeChange
nodes.summary: Suggests a new configuration change and initiates consensus among nodes.

nodes.label: ApplyConfig
nodes.summary: Applies a confirmed configuration change to the cluster's state.

nodes.label: __lt__
nodes.summary: Determines if one protocol instance precedes another in ordering.

nodes.label: __le__
nodes.summary: Determines if one protocol instance precedes or equals another in ordering.

nodes.label: __gt__
nodes.summary: Determines if one protocol instance follows another in ordering.

nodes.label: __ge__
nodes.summary: Determines if one protocol instance follows or equals another in ordering.

nodes.label: __eq__
nodes.summary: Checks whether two protocol instances are equal based on their attributes.

nodes.label: GetLockStatus
nodes.summary: Retrieves the current status of a mutex lock, indicating whether it is held or free.

nodes.label: merkle_report
nodes.summary: Generates a Merkle tree report of node data for consistency checks.

nodes.label: repair_now
nodes.summary: Triggers an immediate repair process to reconcile node state with the cluster.

nodes.label: _sync_from
nodes.summary: Synchronizes the node's state from a specified source node.

nodes.label: _voter_majority_reachable
nodes.summary: Determines if a majority of voter nodes are reachable for consensus.

nodes.label: members_report
nodes.summary: Creates a report listing current cluster members and their statuses.

nodes.label: _capture_snapshot_state
nodes.summary: Captures the current state of the node for snapshotting purposes.

nodes.label: _log_state_change
nodes.summary: Logs changes to the node's state for auditing and debugging.

nodes.label: unsubscribe
nodes.summary: Removes a client from a subscription list, stopping further messages on that channel.

nodes.label: MerkleBegin
nodes.summary: Starts a Merkle tree synchronization process by sending the initial root hash to the client.

nodes.label: MerkleBucket
nodes.summary: Requests a specific bucket of the Merkle tree from the client for comparison during replication.

nodes.label: SnapshotMarker
nodes.summary: Marks the beginning of a snapshot transfer in the replication stream.

nodes.label: local_snapshot
nodes.summary: Creates a snapshot of the current Redis data and writes it to a file for persistence.

nodes.label: _merkle_lookup
nodes.summary: Retrieves a value from the Merkle tree by traversing the tree nodes based on the provided key.

nodes.label: merge_snapshot_states
nodes.summary: Combines multiple snapshot states into a single consolidated state for transaction processing.
